limitations.note: The rewrite counts only valid inputs, fixing the inverted enable, but changes the output cadence from two words per three accepted bytes to one word per pair and drops the word packed from the previous byte’s low nibble and the full current byte.
The passing test explicitly expects no output on the third accepted byte, when the original packing logic with the corrected counter would assert valid and emit 12'hd12.

The first verification command had to be reissued because its cleanup was rejected, and the retried command’s Git check failed outside a repository and had to be replaced with a standalone whitespace check.
